about: Moment pictures the published page leaves out: the tribal and magic world moments, whose lives show their world's tarot card in place of an Earth picture, so these never show. The rarer Earth moments' pictures go in picture packs instead (pic-packs.json), so one published version stays within the artifact's 511 files.
